tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// paṇ+ḍi ta dza mā ri'i lugs kyi 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dza mā ri paṇ+ḍi ta zhes bya ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i mkhas pa yin yang*/ shin tu dbul bar gyur te/ rang dang bu smad kyi 'tsho ba nyin re bzhin du grong du bsod snyoms kyis tshol dgos pa las/ dus re zhig rgya gar shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor pa cig byung nas/ khyod kyi dbul ba 'di sel ba'i thabs shig nga la yod de/ khyed paṇ+ḍi ta bya ba nga rgyal che ba yin pas mi nyan nam zer skad/ bdag shin tu'ang nyan par zhu 'tshal byas pas/ 'o na zla ba phyi ma'i tshes brgyad kyi dus su/ me tog dkar po shing tog sngon po pi tsur+ya pha la dang*/

me tog sngon po 'bras bus gang ba cig yod gsungs/ tsan dan dkar po tshags gyis shig dang*/ nga 'ong gsungs nas de rnams bsags nas bsdad pa dang*/ dus der byon nas 'di gnang*/ 'di'i lag len ni/ maṇ+ḍal rin po che yod na legs/ med na tshad khru gang pa chus mi 'jig pa cig byas la rang kha byang du bltas la/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub snyam du sems bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal thog mar tsan dan gyi chus g.yas skor du gru bzhir byug de nas chos 'byung du/ de nas sor mo kha nang du bstan nas zlum por byugs la/ g.yas su me tog gcig spungs pa jo mo nor rgyun par bsam/ de nyid sku mdog gser btso ma 'dra ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ dar la babs pa/ phyag g.yas pa na pi tsur+ya pha la bzung ba/ g.yon na 'bras kyi snye ma bzung ba/ rin po che'i bum pa zhabs spras pa rin po che 'dzag pa'i steng na/ zhabs gnyis gshibs te bzhengs nas bzhugs pa cig tu wal gyis bsgom/ de nas sngags re brjod cing me tog re phul bas/ jo mo la gdugs dkar po re phul bar bsam/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog re re spungs/ byin rlabs zhu ba yin gsungs/ de nas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun brjod cing thams cad kyis gsol ba gdab/ phyis kyang de bzhin du bya/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gi tshad ni thog mar lung ster 'di'i lung len pa'i dus tshes brgyad yin/ me tog 'bul ba'i dus su mngar gsum khar mur zhing phul na rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ ba'i grangs yin/ gzhan nus tshad du bya'o// paṇ+ḍi ta des zla ba gsum tsam du nus tshad du byas pas/ bi kra ma la shī lar chos kyi grags pa'i pa tra chu'am rgyun/ mi bcu drug re 'tsho ba phul/

gzhan nor dang 'bru la sogs pa mang po thob gsungs/ des bla ma aṃ bha ba la/ des shākya rak+ṣi ta la/ des 'dzim lo tsā ba la/ des bla ma khams pa la/ des ma hā lo tsā ba la'o/ mchod pa'i dus min par zlos pa min no// the tshom za mi dgos gsungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ gha taṃ dzī bā saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ pha la haṣ+ṭi/ bā su dha ri te/ shī baṃ ka ri/ shān+tiṃ ku ru/ paṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ bhā ya na se ni/ sarba duṣ+ṭa na/ bhañdza bhañdza/ dzam+bha dzam+bha/ s+t+wam+bha s+t+wam+bha/ a mṛ te/ uta bha be/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma ka rā dz+ye swā hā/ man ngag 'di yi ge la bkod pa med snyan brgyud yin gsungs/ 'di'i dam tshig ni rang 'dod kyi zhen 'khris med par gzhan don du byed pa dgos gsungs so// zhes dpal khro phu lo tsā ba chen po'i man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ gang la longs spyod phun sum tshogs// dka' ba med par thob 'gyur ba// gnod sbyin mo yi rig sngags mchog /shin tu zab gyur mdo tsam bri// maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa la tsan dan gyi chus phyir gru bzhir byug dbus su zlum skor la thug par byug me tog gi tshom bu bzhi dgod/ me tog dkar po'i phung po dang*/ shing pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu dgos par bshad kyang*/ ma rnyed na bil bas dod bya/ bdag bskyed khro bo gang rung zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su nor rgyun ma gser btso ma lta bu/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ phyag g.yas pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu sngo dmar bsnams pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i bum pa zhabs sprad cing*/ kha gnyis nas rin po che'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa'i steng na mnyam par bzhengs pa/ sngags re re brjod cing me tog re 'bul ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas/ gdugs dkar po re re dbu thog tu byung bar bsam/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can la dngos grub stsal du gsol/

zhes lan bdun gsol ba gdab/ sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ gha taṃ dzī bā saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ pha la haṣ+ṭi/ bā su dha ri te/ shī baṃ ka ri/ shān+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ bhā ya na se ni/ sarba duṣ+ṭa na/ bhāñdza bhāñdza/ dzam+bha dzam+bha/ stam+bha stam+bha/ a mṛ te/ uta bha be/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma ka rā dz+ye swā hā/ zhes pa'o// gshegs gsol mi dgos/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di rgyun gyi nyams len yin la/ bsnyen pa'i tshe/ sngags dang bcas te me tog ci nus su 'bul ba yin la/ 'bum phrag bzhi'am/ zla ba gsum gyis bsnyen pa rdzogs par bzhed do// 'di'i rig gtad ni/ rgyun gyi nyams len de nyid slob dpon gyis tshang bar byas pa'i rjes la/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal dbul/ me tog dkar po bzhi bcu zhe gnyis las mi nyung ba slob dpon gyi phyag tu gtad/ slob dpon gyis me tog de mdun bskyed la dbul/ me tog re slob ma'i spyi bor spungs/ slob ma 'di la dngos grub stsal du gsol zhes brjod/ de ltar lan nyer gcig byas la/ sgrub thabs bshad pa nyid kyis don 'grub pa yin no// mdun bskyed mi dmigs par bzhag pa nyid kyis chog rjes chog mi dgos so// nor rgyun sgrub thabs ches zab pa// kun la ma grags rab dga'i tog /'dzim lo'i man ngag snying po 'di// gsal bar bkod pa'ang rmad du byung*/ dza mā ri'i lugs kyi nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u tshan no// ༈ /'di'i rig gtad skabs/ slob dpon gyi bya ba gong gsal ltar la/ slob ma mdun du 'khod par/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang*/ de la 'dir paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dza mā ri nas brgyud de/ 'dzim lo tsā ba dang*/ khro phu lo chen byams pa'i dpal gyis thugs gtsigs su mdzad pa'i 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i rig gtad zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas me tog dkar po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis las mi nyung ba slob dpon gyi phyag tu 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod la slob mas me tog dbul/

dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su nor rgyun ma sogs nas/ mnyam par bzhengs pa dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa la/ slob dpon gyis sngags re re brjod cing me tog re phul ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byas pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i dbu thog tu gdugs dkar po re re lam lam byung bas 'dod rgu'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal ba'i mos pa mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ sngags re brjod la mdun bskyed la me tog re re dbul/ me tog re re slob ma'i spyi bor spungs la/ slob ma 'di la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de 'dra lan nyer gcig bya/ des sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba yin pas/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs ni 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo la brten nas 'dod rgu'i dngos grub bsgrub par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa la sogs nas/ zla ba gsum gyis bsnyen pa rdzogs par bzhed do// des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dza mā ri'i lugs kyi nor rgyun ma ser mo'i rig gtad zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhes dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gyes/ bdag bskyed khro bo gang rung byed par gsungs pa ni phyag rdor 'byung 'dul lta bu legs shing*/ rig gtad 'di tshes brgyad la bya/ slob mas me tog phul ba'i tshe mngar gsum bza' bzhin du phul na rten 'brel legs par gsungs so// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas bris pa dge/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
